intro.uz: Bu — maktabdagi eʼlon. Eʼlonlarda vaqt, joy va narx muhim. Oʻqiyotganda raqamlarga eʼtibor bering.

paragraphs.en: School trip for Class 7B! On Friday, 14 March, we go to the History Museum in Tashkent.
paragraphs.uz: 7B sinfi uchun maktab sayohati! 14-mart, juma kuni biz Toshkentdagi Tarix muzeyiga boramiz.

paragraphs.en: The bus leaves the school at 8:30 in the morning. Please come to school at 8:15. Don't be late! We come back at 3 o'clock.
paragraphs.uz: Avtobus maktabdan ertalab soat 8:30 da joʻnaydi. Iltimos, maktabga 8:15 da keling. Kechikmang! Soat 3 da qaytamiz.

paragraphs.en: The ticket costs 20,000 sum. Bring your lunch and a bottle of water. You can't eat in the museum, but there is a small park next to it.
paragraphs.uz: Chipta 20 000 soʻm turadi. Tushlik va bir shisha suv olib keling. Muzey ichida ovqatlanish mumkin emas, lekin uning yonida kichik bogʻ bor.

paragraphs.en: Please give this paper to your parents. They must sign it. Bring it back to Ms Karimova by Wednesday.
paragraphs.uz: Iltimos, bu qogʻozni ota-onangizga bering. Ular uni imzolashi kerak. Uni chorshanbagacha oʻqituvchi Karimovaga qaytaring.

grammar.example: The bus leaves the school at 8:30.

explain.uz: «On Friday, 14 March». Chorshanba — qogʻozni qaytarish kuni.

questions.statement: Students must come to school at 8:30.
The class comes back at 3 o'clock.
Students can eat their lunch in the museum.

explain.uz: «You can't eat in the museum» — yonidagi bogʻda yeyish mumkin.
«Please give this paper to your parents. They must sign it.»

questions.prompt: Students give the paper back to Ms ___.

explain.uz: «Bring it back to Ms Karimova by Wednesday.»
